name: Ethereum mainnet chain split (old Geth)
technique: Silently patched consensus bug; un-upgraded nodes forked
rootCause: A consensus bug fixed silently in Geth v1.9.17 was triggered on mainnet. Infura and others running older Geth followed a minority fork, breaking MetaMask, Binance withdrawals and many dapps for hours. Lesson: silent fixes require everyone to upgrade.
